evals.prompt: Create a GNOME Shell extension with a panel indicator and a preference that can hide the indicator. Target the GNOME Shell version installed on this machine.
evals.expected_output: A complete version-aware ESM extension with metadata, symmetric lifecycle cleanup, Libadwaita preferences, GSettings, and validation instructions.
expectations: Detects or explicitly establishes the installed GNOME Shell major before writing shell-version metadata
Uses Extension and ExtensionPreferences default-exported ES module classes for GNOME 45 or later
Creates the panel actor in enable and destroys and nulls it in disable
Keeps Gtk and Adw in prefs.js rather than extension.js
Includes a schema below org.gnome.shell.extensions and a repeatable test and packaging loop

evals.prompt: My GNOME extension works once, but after disabling and enabling it again I get two callbacks and the old panel icon remains. Diagnose and fix it.
evals.expected_output: An evidence-led lifecycle diagnosis that traces every enabled resource to cleanup and verifies repeated cycles.
expectations: Inspects the existing enable and disable paths before changing code
Finds missing actor destruction and signal disconnection rather than adding enabled flags
Keeps cleanup with the component that owns each resource
Tests enable, disable, and re-enable while watching the Shell journal
Does not restart or terminate the user's primary Shell without authorization

evals.prompt: Port this GNOME Shell 44 extension using imports.ui.main and init() to Shell 48, and make its preferences review-ready.
evals.expected_output: A deliberate Shell 45+ ESM port with corrected resource paths, modern preferences, lifecycle cleanup, and review checks.
expectations: Replaces legacy imports and init with a default-exported Extension subclass
Uses the distinct case-sensitive resource paths for extension.js and prefs.js
Does not claim one entry point can run unchanged on both sides of the Shell 45 ESM boundary
Uses fillPreferencesWindow with GTK 4 and Libadwaita
Audits private API changes and applies the EGO review checklist
